## Current behavior `NoConflictStyleCompatibilityMode` has been removed in material2 and after upgrading my app I get the following error with `ng serve` **Note**: The issue only raised when importing module with ```ts { ngModule: NoConflictStyleCompatibilityMode } ``` ```console ERROR in TypeError: staticSymbol.assertNoMembers is not a function at AotSummaryResolver.resolveSummary (node_modules/@angular/compiler/bundles/compiler.umd.js:31928:22) at CompileMetadataResolver._loadSummary (node_modules/@angular/compiler/bundles/compiler.umd.js:14709:66) at CompileMetadataResolver.isDirective (node_modules/@angular/compiler/bundles/compiler.umd.js:15003:23) at CompileMetadataResolver._getTypeDescriptor (node_modules/@angular/compiler/bundles/compiler.umd.js:15269:18) at node_modules/@angular/compiler/bundles/compiler.umd.js:15131:78 at Array.forEach () at CompileMetadataResolver.getNgModuleMetadata (node_modules/@angular/compiler/bundles/compiler.umd.js:15114:49) at node_modules/@angular/compiler/bundles/compiler.umd.js:30090:70 at Array.forEach () at analyzeFile (node_modules/@angular/compiler/bundles/compiler.umd.js:30069:53) at AotCompiler._analyzeFile (node_modules/@angular/compiler/bundles/compiler.umd.js:29289:17) at AotCompiler.findGeneratedFileNames (node_modules/@angular/compiler/bundles/compiler.umd.js:29305:42) at Object.findGeneratedFileNames (node_modules/@angular/compiler-cli/src/transformers/program.js:387:82) at TsCompilerAotCompilerTypeCheckHostAdapter.getSourceFile (node_modules/@angular/compiler-cli/src/transformers/compiler_host.js:325:55) at tryReuseStructureFromOldProgram (node_modules/typescript/lib/typescript.js:70032:28) at Object.createProgram (node_modules/typescript/lib/typescript.js:69763:34) ``` ## Expected behavior ```console ERROR in Error: Unexpected value 'NoConflictStyleCompatibilityMode in node_modules/@angular/material/core.d.ts' imported by the module 'AppModule in src/app/app.module.ts'. Please add a @NgModule annotation. ``` ## Minimal reproduction of the problem with instructions see https://github.com/aitboudad/ng-cli-19994 ```ts import { NoConflictStyleCompatibilityMode } from '@angular/material/core'; @NgModule({ declarations: [], imports: [ ... { ngModule: NoConflictStyleCompatibilityMode }, ], }) export class AppModule { } ``` ## What is the motivation / use case for changing the behavior? ## Environment
